description: Which OSV ecosystem answers for a package URL: a purl type (or type/namespace for a distribution's packages) -> the OSV ecosystem name. The OSV query asks OSV only about a component whose ecosystem the captured ecosystems.txt lists; every other component is recorded not_indexed, and its release's OSV coverage is partial. A type missing here is not indexed (brew, generic, docker, oci, cocoapods, conda, github ...). Edit it by authoring a successor of the osv-applicability Procedure; keep the sources.
sources: https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/#defined-ecosystems (OSV ecosystem names and the purl type each uses)
https://osv-vulnerabilities.storage.googleapis.com/ecosystems.txt (what OSV indexes now: captured on every run)
